mutations.name: Jcode short socket directory refuses foreign owner
mutations.find:
if (uid !== currentUid)
    throw new Error(`refusing Jcode short API socket directory owned by uid ${uid}, not effective uid ${currentUid}: ${path}`);
mutations.expectRed: root connector refuses a foreign-owned deterministic socket directory

mutations.name: Jcode fatal preserves safe startup code
mutations.expectRed: host launch failure reports the safe SDK startup code

mutations.name: Jcode fatal excludes captured child stderr
mutations.find: process.stderr.write(`[cotal-jcode] fatal: Jcode host startup failed (${startupFailureCode(error)}); inspect the private Jcode logs.\n`);
mutations.expectRed: host launch failure never prints captured Jcode child stderr canary
